__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource used by all panels

panels.title: 1. Query funnel — what happened to each open
1. Client redirects / s
panels.description: AAA r-stream: every redirect this redirector sent to a client (locate, open, …). This is redirector demand, independent of OpenVerify.

panels.title: 2. Opens classified / s
panels.description: Every plugin open() that ran Rucio-first locate (sum of rucio_lookups_total). One count per open, including cmsd-stall retries of the same LFN.

panels.title: 3. Rucio accepted / s
panels.description: Opens that finished on a verified (or positive-cache) Rucio replica. The client was redirected to a Rucio PFN gateway.

panels.title: 4. cmsd accepted / s
panels.description: Opens that fell through to cmsd and then passed OpenVerify on a cmsd site hop. Much smaller than (2)−(3): stalls, transit, and cmsd failures are not accepts.

panels.title: 5. Transit / s
panels.description: Static xrootd.redirect to cms-xrd-transit (ENOENT fallback). Successful pass-through, not a verify error. Typical for files cmsd also cannot place.

panels.title: cmsd stalls / s
panels.description: cmsd returned SFS_STALL. The plugin returns wait to the client; the next open() is counted again in (2). Stalls explain skipped+empty >> cmsd accepts.

panels.title: Fell through to cmsd / s
panels.description: Rucio did not accept: skip + empty + auth/timeout/error + replica exhaust. These opens then hit cmsd (and maybe transit/stall).

panels.title: Rucio share of accepts
panels.description: Rucio accepted / (Rucio + cmsd accepted). Excludes transit (successful ENOENT hop) and stalls.

panels.title: Each open() outcome
panels.description: Every plugin open() ends in exactly one of these. The thick line is opens classified (2) — the stack should track it. Stall = client will retry (another open). Transit = cms-xrd-transit. Retry exhausted = cmsd used 3 sites, last redirect returned unverified.

panels.title: Why Rucio did not accept
panels.description: Reasons an open fell through to cmsd. skipped = ignore prefix (/store/user, /tmp). empty = no usable disk PFN. exhausted = replicas existed but none verified. infra = auth/timeout/error. Stack ≈ (6) Fell through.

panels.title: Accepted landing (Rucio / cmsd / transit)
panels.description: Where a successful client redirect came from. rucio = verified Rucio PFN. cmsd = verified cmsd site. xrootd = transit ENOENT hop (no verify). Does not include stalls or failed locates — see Each open() outcome.

panels.title: Redirector demand by type
panels.description: AAA r-stream redirects split by opcode. Thick total = (1) Client redirects. OpenVerify classification is (2); they differ when stall retries or non-open opcodes dominate.

panels.title: Rucio soft-fail / s
panels.description: empty + auth_error + timeout + error. No Rucio probe ran; open went to cmsd. Does not include skipped or exhausted.

panels.title: Rucio replicas exhausted / s
panels.description: lookup=ok but no PFN accepted. Next hop is cmsd (then maybe recovered — see cmsd path).

panels.title: Rucio probe failures / s
panels.description: Live probes that failed against a Rucio-chosen replica. Filtered by Site and Error reason.

panels.title: Rucio list cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of list_replicas lookups served from the (lfn, scheme) LRU. Hits skip REST; misses proceed to auth/POST and then appear in Rucio lookups (REST).

panels.title: Rucio step 1 — list_replicas decision
panels.description: First thing Rucio-first does: classify the LFN. ok = disk PFNs returned (then try verify). skipped = ignore prefix, no REST. empty / auth / timeout / error = soft-fail to cmsd. Includes list-cache hits for ok/empty.

panels.title: Rucio step 1b — skipped by prefix
panels.description: Ignore-prefix skips split by the matched XRD_OPENVERIFY_RUCIO_IGNORE_PREFIX. Needs OpenVerify 0.5.4+. Canary: /store/user and /tmp.

panels.title: Rucio step 2 — which replica was accepted
panels.description: For lookup=ok: which ordered PFN passed verify (replica 1…5+). exhausted = every replica failed or was skipped → cmsd. Observe mode only tries replica 1.

panels.title: Rucio probe failures by error
panels.description: Why Rucio-selected probes fail (timeout, auth, not found, …). Uses Site and Error reason filters.

panels.title: Rucio redirect destinations (failures)
panels.description: Destinations that failed a live probe on the Rucio locate path. Uses Site and Error reason filters. Legend sorted by mean rate.

panels.title: Rucio redirect destination failures (selected time range)
panels.description: Total Rucio-path probe failures in the dashboard time range, by destination and error. Sorted by count.

panels.title: Rucio list cache hits / s
panels.description: LRU hits — no REST call. Does not appear in Rucio lookups (REST).

panels.title: Rucio list cache misses / s
panels.description: LRU misses — each miss becomes one Rucio lookups (REST) outcome (ok/empty/…).

panels.title: Rucio list_replicas p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Timeseries of cache-miss list_replicas wall time (Acquire + optional auth + POST). Not the site probe. Cache hits are not included.

panels.title: cmsd step 1 — lookup stalls
panels.description: cmsd returned SFS_STALL before a destination. Client waits and retries; that retry is a new open() (counted again in the funnel). Not a site failure.

panels.title: cmsd step 2 — which hop was accepted
panels.description: Which cmsd redirect candidate passed verify (attempt 1–3). exhausted = retry budget spent, last redirect returned unverified (enforce only).

panels.title: cmsd retries exhausted / s
panels.description: Opens that used up the cmsd retry budget without a successful probe. Near 0 when retries are not enabled.

panels.title: cmsd recovered after Rucio exhaust / s
panels.description: Rucio had replicas, all failed verify, then cmsd openverify accepted. Subset of cmsd accepts.

panels.title: cmsd recovery ratio after Rucio exhaust
panels.description: recovered / exhausted: fraction of Rucio-exhaust opens that cmsd then saved. Use with the absolute rate — a high ratio on tiny volume is less meaningful.

panels.title: cmsd probe failures / s
panels.description: Live probes that failed against a cmsd-chosen redirect. Filtered by Site and Error reason.

panels.title: cmsd probe failures by error
panels.description: Why cmsd-selected probes fail. Uses Site and Error reason filters.

panels.title: cmsd redirect destinations (failures)
panels.description: Destinations that failed a live probe on the cmsd locate path. Uses Site and Error reason filters. Legend sorted by mean rate.

panels.title: cmsd redirect destination failures (selected time range)
panels.description: Total cmsd-path probe failures in the dashboard time range, by destination and error. Sorted by count.

panels.title: Top client redirect destinations
panels.description: Site gateways receiving the most client redirects (AAA r-stream; all locate paths). Rucio-path and cmsd-path destinations are broken out under verify errors.

panels.title: All client redirect destinations
panels.description: Full sortable list of client redirect destinations (AAA r-stream; all locate paths). For Rucio vs cmsd destination failures, use the verify-error tables below.

panels.title: OpenVerify redirects / s
panels.description: Redirect hops that entered the OpenVerify plugin. Compare with the AAA total above; they should be close when OpenVerify is on the open path.

panels.title: Verify failure rate
panels.description: Share of live probe opens that failed. Only counts hops that actually ran a probe (cache misses). Queue rejects are not included.

panels.title: Queue rejects / s
panels.description: Global FIFO: queue full or waited too long. These requeue once and do not add the site to tried=. Per-site inflight cap is host_busy (see Per-site inflight busy).

panels.title: Unhealthy sites
panels.description: How many sites currently score as unhealthy (EWMA quarantine). Zero while the fail-safe is tripped (mass-quarantine circuit breaker released them). In observe mode clients are still redirected there; OpenVerify tries to skip them.

panels.title: Positive cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of lookups that found a recent successful probe and skipped a new live open.

panels.title: Negative cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of lookups that found a recent failed probe. In observe mode the redirect is still returned; OpenVerify asks for another site.

panels.title: Successful verify time
panels.description: Average time for a successful live probe. See the Verify time chart for success vs failure.

panels.title: Verify outcomes
panels.description: Rate of probe opens that succeeded or failed. Does not include cache hits or queue rejects.

panels.title: Cache lookups
panels.description: What the probe cache returned: hit_positive = reuse a good result; miss = run a live probe; hit_negative = remember a recent failure.

panels.title: Verify queue
panels.description: admitted = got a probe slot; queue_timeout / queue_full = global FIFO (requeued, not tried=); host_busy = this site already at 50% of MAX_INFLIGHT (skipped via tried=).

panels.title: Verify time (success vs failure)
panels.description: Average live-probe duration. Failures often sit near the verify timeout when sites hang.

panels.title: Redirect delay (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: How long OpenVerify holds the client redirect before accepting or retrying (queue wait + probe). Spikes often mean timeouts. Use the heatmap and Delay outcome filter to see which path dominates.

panels.title: Redirect delay distribution
panels.description: Full distribution of redirect hold time. Use the Delay outcome variable to focus on verify success/failure, queue rejects, cache hits, or avoided redirects. Does not include cmsd SFS_STALL (client-owned lookup delay).

panels.title: TCP reuse ratio
panels.description: Share of Rucio HTTP transfers with CURLINFO_NUM_CONNECTS==0 (keep-alive). Low under load means Rucio/proxy closes connections or idle > MAXAGE_CONN.

panels.title: Easy-handle reuse ratio
panels.description: Share of transfers that reused an idle pooled CURL* (vs curl_easy_init under load). Warm min should keep this high once the pool is filled.

panels.title: Pool handles (now)
panels.description: Current easy handles in the elastic pool (between POOL_MIN and POOL_MAX).

panels.title: Pool inflight (now)
panels.description: Checked-out easy handles currently in a Rucio auth/list transfer.

panels.title: TCP connection reuse
panels.description: reused = CURLINFO_NUM_CONNECTS==0; new = opened a TCP(+TLS) connection for this transfer.

panels.title: Easy-handle reuse
panels.description: reused = Acquire returned an idle pooled handle; new = pool grew with curl_easy_init.

panels.title: Curl pool size
panels.description: handles = total easies; idle = available; inflight = checked out. Should rise with concurrent list_replicas, then fall after idle TTL (~15s).

panels.title: Curl pool grow / shrink
panels.description: grows = demand-driven creates above warm min; shrinks = idle extras destroyed. Sustained grow without shrink → stuck at high size or max.

panels.title: Quarantine burst (fail-safe)
panels.description: How close OpenVerify is to the mass-quarantine circuit breaker. 'entered quarantine in window' is unique sites that crossed into quarantine during FAILSAFE_WINDOW (default 5m). The dashed line is the trip threshold (default 8). 'currently quarantined' is sites OpenVerify is skipping now. If the window count hits the threshold, fail-safe trips (red bars, right axis): those sites are released and skip is disabled until the hold expires.

panels.title: Site health score (higher = worse)
panels.description: EWMA badness (0 = healthy, 1 = worst). Yellow line = recover (0.4); red = quarantine (0.6). Top 15 non-zero sites.

panels.title: Site status (selected time range)
panels.description: Current health score and healthy flag, plus probe success/failure counts over the dashboard time range. healthy=0 means the site is quarantined in the EWMA score.

panels.title: Bad redirects avoided / s
panels.description: Redirects skipped because the site was quarantined or in the negative cache (client gets tried= and another site). Near 0 when avoidance is not active.

panels.title: Avoidance rate
panels.description: Avoided redirects as a share of OpenVerify-handled redirects. Near 0 when avoidance is not active.

panels.title: Avoided redirects by reason
panels.description: quarantine = EWMA-unhealthy site skipped; negative_cache = recent failed probe remembered; host_busy = site already at 50% of MAX_INFLIGHT. Flat near 0 when avoidance is not active.

panels.title: Per-site inflight busy
panels.description: This host already held 50% of MAX_INFLIGHT probe slots, so OpenVerify skipped it via tried= (not EWMA quarantine). Use the Site filter. Distinct from Verify queue timeout/full (global FIFO).

title: CMS XRootD OpenVerify
description: Read top to bottom: (1) query funnel — demand, Rucio vs cmsd vs transit vs stall; (2) Rucio path in order; (3) cmsd path in order. Later rows are destinations, plugin internals, curl pool, and site health. Hover a panel title for the metric.
